rationale: The plan matches the reference exactly: a DESeq2 LRT of ~condition + time + condition:time against ~condition + time, with explicit reference levels (t0, control), printed interaction coefficients, and per-time-point contrasts pulled from the single fit rather than refit subsets. QC includes PCA coloured by condition/shaped by time and a sample-distance heatmap, but library sizes are not inspected and there is no stated policy for an outlier or shallow sample. The low-count rule (>=10 in >=3 samples, before the fit, count retained reported) is minimal and appropriate; normalization is implicitly DESeq2 size factors on raw counts and TMM for the voom track, though size-factor estimation is not spelled out. BH at 0.05 is stated and shrinkage is applied to the per-time-point effects only 'where appropriate'; enrichment is added though not warranted, and while the universe and collections are explicit, no collection version or gene-set size window is given. Package versions are not part of the reporting requirements.
